summary: Frontend-only retest completed on public URL. Inicio banner behavior matches request: only image is visible, 16:9 card fit, rounded corners, no overflow, and click navigation to /juegos works. No regression found in garra indicator or bottom navigation.

Large single-file component composition in App.js makes targeted UI changes riskier; consider modularizing by route/screen.

rca of the issue: Original concern was visual composition mismatch (image, text/arrow overlay, and fitting). Current CSS override in BrandOverrides.css enforces aspect-ratio: 16/9, width/height 100%, object-fit: cover, overflow hidden, and hidden div/svg descendants; this directly eliminates visible text/arrow/oval while preserving click-through navigation.
